einzeiler: Mel and Gary Vaynerchuk discuss overcoming fear, excuses, and self-doubt.
kurzfassung: Mel talks with Gary Vaynerchuk about how to stop making excuses and change your life. They discuss dealing with fear, regret, comparison, and other people's opinions. The conversation also covers starting a business, changing careers, and taking risks.
stichpunkte: Discussion on fear, regret, comparison, and confidence
How to stop making excuses and overcome feeling stuck
Advice on starting a business and changing careers
What your algorithm reveals about you
Why peace of mind matters more than status
How to stop blaming parents for circumstances and build self-confidence
beschreibung:
This episode is a MUST-listen.

If you’ve ever felt behind, scared, stuck, or doubting yourself, you need to hit play.

Today, Mel sits down with someone who has been a mentor from afar for more than 12 years. Mel says she would not be where she is today without the person sitting across from her.

For more than a decade, Gary Vaynerchuk has been one of Mel’s biggest inspirations - and in this conversation, he is here to challenge you to stop making excuses and start changing your life.

Gary is one of the most successful entrepreneurs and creators of his generation, a six-time New York Times bestselling author, and the force behind VaynerX, VaynerMedia, and VeeFriends.

If you’ve been sitting on an idea, watching other people do the thing you want to do, worrying about what people will think, or telling yourself you’re too late, you need to hear this.

Gary will challenge the way you think about fear, regret, comparison, confidence, your career, other people’s opinions, and the excuses that are keeping you stuck.

You’ll learn why the people you listen to shape who you become, why your embarrassment can become your advantage, why peace of mind matters more than status, and why one action could change the entire direction of your life.

Gary also shares his advice for anyone who wants to start a business, change careers, put themselves out there, or finally take the risk they’ve been thinking about for years.

His message is simple: there is something you are amazing at - and the longer you sit around watching everybody else do it, the more it costs you.

You’ll also learn:
- What your algorithm reveals about who you are
- Why you need to start living your life with your funeral in mind
- The 3 words that are keeping you stuck
- Gary’s #1 tip if you’re unemployed or looking for a new job
- How to stop blaming your parents for your circumstances
- How to build self-confidence and let go of your need to be accepted
- Why peace of mind is the secret to a rich life

This conversation will push you to stop waiting for the right time, stop letting other people’s opinions control your decisions, and stop living in a way that leaves you saying, “I wish I…”

By the time it’s over, you’ll know exactly what you need to do next - and you’ll feel inspired to go do it.

For more resources related to today’s episode, click here for the podcast episode page.

If you liked this episode, listen to this one next: What Makes a Good Life? This Study on 26,000 Regrets Will Guide You for the Rest of Your Life
